draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.71, the 8th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 12 at TE. He went 13th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: George Kittle. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2023) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Las Vegas Raiders. 29 career games and 24 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 5 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: receiving td 7 (96th percentile), team target share 17.4% (92nd percentile), receiving yards 680 (91st percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 tight end who played: 680 receiving yards against a median of 128, above the norm.
